botReplays.start:
Welcome to Israel's wave forecast bot 🏄‍♂️

/${getForecastCmd} - current forecast (Tel-Aviv)
/${spotsCmd} - forecast for other spots
/${subscribeCmd} - daily forecast every morning
/${liveVideoCmd} - live cam

/${langHeCmd} החלף שפה לעברית
botReplays.help:
Commands:
/${getForecastCmd} [spot] - wave forecast
/${spotsCmd} - list spots
/${subscribeCmd} [spot] - toggle the daily forecast
/${liveVideoCmd} - live cam
/${langEnCmd} · /${langHeCmd} - language
